capabilities: Move notes older than a set age into an archive vault
Copy linked attachments along with archived notes
Preview the archive plan with conflicts and missing attachments
Exclude folders and file types from archiving
Commit and push the archive vault to Git
disambiguation: Not a backup or versioning tool; it moves notes and attachments out into a second vault.
extras: Closed-source and free with no plugin account; desktop only (Windows and macOS, Obsidian 1.5.0+). Recommends backing up both vaults and pausing sync and external edits during archiving.
motivation: Years of notes and attachments made the author's vault slow to sync across a phone and several computers, and keeping the whole vault on the phone used a lot of storage; the author wanted a small active vault plus separate archive vaults.
problem: Vaults with years of notes and attachments sync slowly across devices and take up a lot of storage on a phone.

relations.evidence: the plugin calls your local Git executable to send the archive commit to the remote

summary: Moves notes older than a chosen age, together with their attachments, into a separate archive vault while keeping the original folder structure.
